title: Restrained functional visual direction
summary: A sober, utilitarian tool look: one restrained blue pair for identity and action, with saturated color reserved strictly for functional state signaling.
defaults: Hue: one restrained primary blue (#294D73) and dark blue (#192E45) pair carrying identity and actions; reserve green and red strictly for status
Surface: plain, muted, unornamented light background with calm neutral tones
Density: compact utilitarian density — clear rows, tight controls, information over decoration
Saturated colors appear only where they signal state: connected, active, error, success
risks: Decorative color creeping into a tool-like surface
The restrained blue pair drifting toward saturated marketing hues
Muted body text dropping below 4.5:1 contrast
verification: Saturated color appears only on actions and functional status
Body text reaches 4.5:1 and status color pairs 3:1 contrast

example_startups.name: Mullvad VPN
example_startups.note: Restrained blue/dark-blue pair where green and red exist only to signal connection state

visual_rules: Use exactly one signature accent color, sparingly, for identity and primary CTAs
Derive all neutral tones from one base hue at varying opacities; never use pure #000000 or #FFFFFF
Keep body text contrast at least 4.5:1 and button or CTA contrast at least 3:1 against adjacent colors
Never combine three or more saturated hues in one view
